title: Matchings-Jack statistic for Jack connection coefficients

scoring.case_score: 1 if every generated (pi, sigma)-graded coefficient equals the public target coefficient and mjack is zero exactly on the public bipartite matchings, else 0
scoring.large_probe_pointwise_check: on every large probe, the submitted exponent must be zero if and only if the matching is bipartite
scoring.problem_score: all public lambda fibers and the public zero locus must match, then shuffled replay, the value audit, and resource gates (including the large-probe zero-locus check) must pass; passing is necessary, not sufficient

name: match_jack_connection_q_stat
